2609.29964.title: World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal
2609.29964.paper_summary: General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) bring broad knowledge and spatial reasoning to robot manipulation, yet existing systems either use them indirectly, to predict constraints or write programs, or give them a view of the scene rather than a world in which to act. We present World Action Agent (WAA), a multi-agent harness through which VLMs pilot robots with basic tools, making every decision within a visual action workspace. The workspace has three properties. Contact views, selected automatically from the scene geometry, present the scene around the current interaction. Action rehearsal turns each action into an editable proposal that the agent, alone or through an Imagination Agent, previews and revises against planning feedback before execution. In-view correction closes the loop between observation, rehearsal, and low-level execution, letting the agent remove residual offsets in the view where it observes them. Through the same workspace, WAA acquires embodied procedural knowledge in two ways: it evolves multimodal skills from expert videos and human teaching under evidence-based review and consults them through a Skill Agent, and its interaction traces train smaller VLMs to pilot the same harness. On LIBERO-Pro, WAA with skills evolved only from LIBERO-90 reaches a state-of-the-art 75.6% average success, outperforming end-to-end VLAs, code-as-policy agents, and a visual-harness baseline with the same backbone; the same skills remain effective on robosuite without further learning. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on harness traces raises its out-of-domain success from 1.7% to 43.3%.
2609.29964.paper_summary_zh: 一般用途的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）為機器人操作帶來廣泛的知識和空間推理，然而現有系統要麼間接使用它們來預測約束或編寫程序，要麼僅給它們提供場景的視圖，而不是一個可以行動的世界。我們提出了世界行動代理（WAA），這是一個多代理系統，通過它，VLMs 能夠駕駛配備基本工具的機器人，在視覺行動工作空間內做出每一個決策。該工作空間具有三個特性。接觸視圖自動從場景幾何中選擇，展示當前互動周圍的場景。行動排練將每個行動轉化為可編輯的提案，代理可以單獨或通過想像代理預覽並根據規劃反饋進行修訂，然後再執行。在視圖修正則關閉了觀察、排練和低級執行之間的循環，讓代理能夠消除它觀察到的視圖中的殘餘偏移。通過相同的工作空間，WAA 以兩種方式獲得具身的程序性知識：它從專家視頻和人類教學中在基於證據的審查下發展多模態技能，並通過技能代理進行諮詢；其互動痕跡則訓練較小的 VLMs 來駕駛相同的系統。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，僅從 LIBERO-90 演變而來的技能的 WAA 達到了 75.6% 的最新平均成功率，超越了端到端的 VLA、代碼作為政策的代理和具有相同骨幹的視覺系統基線；這些相同的技能在 robosuite 上也保持有效，而無需進一步學習。對 Qwen3.5-9B 在系統痕跡上進行微調，將其域外成功率從 1.7% 提高到 43.3%。
